docs.kettle.md:
# Kettle

The Zorbo kettle boils one litre of water in ninety seconds. Its handle is made of bamboo and stays cool.

## Cleaning

Descale the kettle every month with white vinegar. Never put the base in the dishwasher.
docs.bike.md:
# Bicycle

The Velox bicycle has eleven gears and a carbon frame weighing seven kilograms.

## Tyres

Inflate the tyres to eighty psi before every ride. Replace the inner tube if it loses pressure overnight.
docs.garden.md:
# Garden

Tomatoes need six hours of direct sunlight each day. Water them at the roots in the early morning.

## Pests

Aphids can be removed with a spray of soapy water. Ladybirds are natural predators of aphids.
